summary: Using the metaphor of rotting leaves smothering a plant, this sermon identifies spiritual obstacles that hinder growth in believers, focusing primarily on unforgiveness. Drawing from Matthew 18 and the parable of the unmerciful servant, the pastor teaches that bitterness destroys the soul and that true forgiveness is a Spirit-empowered process moving from willful choice to heart-level release.
key_points: Pride, judgmentalism, causing temptation, and unforgiveness are obstacles that smother spiritual growth
Confrontation should pursue reconciliation, not accusation
Unforgiveness is like a root that slowly destroys a foundation
God connects receiving forgiveness with extending forgiveness to others
True forgiveness moves through stages from naming the offense to blessing the offender
big_idea: Unforgiveness is a destructive force that smothers spiritual health, and believers must move beyond willful forgiveness to Spirit-empowered heart-level release in order to experience the growth God intends.
title: ALL IN: Your Soul's Health
